author: ojiudezue
title: v5.103.53 shipped: Fan trust follows sensor capability; per-room radar settings; memory writers live again
summary: Fan trust follows sensor capability; per-room radar settings; memory writers live again
why: Fan-noise rejection keyed on a list label, so radars filed outside presence_sensors got no rejection; routing by capability fixes the class with a kill switch. Radar tuning was manual per device in Z2M; a small settings block that sends only on save lets operators tune ZK/ZX radars from URA safely. Three memory writers had silently written nothing since v5.78 because the scheduler omitted HA's required task name, which blinded memory in the Study A fan investigation; fixing it plus a weekly zero-row check prevents a repeat.
implications: Shipped OCCUPANCY-SOURCE-FOLLOWS-CAPABILITY-1, URA-SENSOR-TUNING-1, MEMORY-WRITERS-SILENT-DROP-1 at v5.103.53; card(s) sit shipped_organic pending validation. Acceptance in README_v5.103.53.md (Live criteria).
revisit_trigger: If fan-room false vacancy rises after the capability routing, if a radar setting is reported not applied, or if the weekly memory check fires.
